===== EXP16: 空密码账号能否走 TCP？（验证: 限制来自 Account 匹配, 不是空密码本身）=====
user	host	auth_str_len
empty_test	%	0
empty_test	127.0.0.1	0
empty_test	localhost	0

--- 1) socket ---
USER()	CURRENT_USER()
empty_test@localhost	empty_test@localhost

--- 2) TCP 127.0.0.1 ---
USER()	CURRENT_USER()
empty_test@127.0.0.1	empty_test@127.0.0.1

--- 3) TCP 本机 IP (192.168.101.129) ---
USER()	CURRENT_USER()
empty_test@192.168.101.129	empty_test@%

--- 对照: root 只有 @localhost, TCP 无匹配 Account ---
user	host
root	localhost
ERROR 1045 (28000): Access denied for user 'root'@'127.0.0.1' (using password: NO)

--- 清理 ---
